notes: visitbeijing.com.cn and s.visitbeijing.com.cn are run by 北京市文化和旅游局宣传中心, a municipal tourism publicity body, not by the attraction operators. Their articles carry '北京旅游网原创' with a staff editor. The two articles bylined '漫谈京津冀' (2024-09-20, 2024-10-21) are column pieces and stale. The attraction pages have no date.
Summer Palace: the operator site summerpalace-china.com was unreachable (503 or timeout). Operating values rest on the undated portal page, so a recheck against the operator is recommended.
Tiananmen: c11, c14 and c15 rest only on a stale 2022 COVID-era FAQ. c16 is superseded by the 2026-10-07 guidance.
Zhangjiajie: every source is from 2015-2016. Physical figures can stay with their dates, but the record has no current operating information (hours, fees, booking, opening status).
Coordinates were not supplied and not checked against OSM.
